sections.howItWorksStep1Body: Use structured filters or plain language — whichever is easier.
sections.howItWorksStep2Body: See caregivers ranked by fit, with a clear explanation for each.
sections.howItWorksStep3Body: Create a free account to contact or hire a caregiver.
sections.verifiedBody: Caregivers with a verified qualification have had their credentials checked against the issuing institution. We show this clearly so you can weigh it in your decision.
sections.safetyBody: We never show a caregiver's contact details, address, or identification documents publicly. Sensitive health information is kept separate and is never part of public search.
sections.multilingualBody: This site works in English, Sinhala, and Tamil.
sections.ctaTitle: Ready to find the right caregiver?
sections.ctaBody: Start with a search above — no account needed.

footer.disclaimer: Search results are ranked automatically based on the filters you provide. They are not a recommendation or guarantee of fit.

landing.heroTitle: Find trusted caregivers. Manage care with confidence.
landing.heroBody: One platform for families, caregivers and care teams — search verified professionals by skill, language and location, and run the whole operation from a single staff portal.
landing.panelBody: Every profile is reviewed by our care team before it appears in search.

apps.title: Everything in one place
apps.body: Each app is built for a different audience and shares the same verified caregiver data.

finder.title: Caregiver Finder
finder.body: Search by skill, language, availability and location — with smart matching and privacy-safe profiles.

account.title: Sign in / Register
account.body: Caregivers build and maintain their profile; guardians register and verify their email to get started.

register.title: Create a free account
register.body: Contact caregivers directly, save your favourites and send hire requests once you are signed up.

api.title: REST API
api.body: The API behind every app, documented with interactive Swagger and role-based access.

steps.title: From sign-up to a verified match
steps.step1Body: Create a profile with skills, languages, availability and documents.
steps.step2Body: Care teams review submissions and approve profiles for the public directory.
steps.step3Body: Filter and match by need, location and language, with personal details protected.
steps.step4Body: Role-based access and a complete audit trail keep everything accountable.

gallery.title: Built on trust
gallery.body: The things that matter most when you are choosing someone to care for a family member.
gallery.verifiedBody: Credentials are checked against the issuing institution before a profile goes live.
gallery.languageBody: Search and sign up in English, Sinhala or Tamil.
gallery.privacyBody: Contact details, addresses and documents are never shown in public search.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
